channel.description: Latest articles from BK Reader (The Brooklyn Reader) (bkreader.com)

item.title: Brooklyn Borough President Funds 5 Mobility Vans For Midwood Org
item.description: HASC Center in Midwood purchased five wheelchair-accessible vans with $564,000 in FY26 capital funding allocated by Brooklyn Borough President Antonio Reynoso. They will be used to transport Brooklynites with developmental disabilities to medical appointments and recreational activities.

item.title: Brooklyn Filmmaker Raises a Drink to a Historic Brooklyn Dive Bar
item.description: In his namesake documentary, Brooklyn filmmaker Leon Chase captures the colorful staff and rotating cast of oddball patrons during the final months of Hank’s Saloon, a beloved dive bar in Boerum Hill.

item.title: Brooklyn Memorial Honors Children Killed in Gaza
item.description: Created by artist Phil Buehler and Radio Free Brooklyn, the Wall of Tears memorial in Bushwick honors 18,457 Palestinian children killed since Oct. 7, 2023.

item.title: Michael G. Johnson Named Executive Director of Cypress Hills LDC
item.description: Cypress Hills Local Development Corporation announced the appointment of Michael G. Johnson as its new executive director, succeeding longtime leader Michelle Neugebauer.

item.title: Feb 7: Brooklyn Black History Maker, Gabourey Sidibe
item.description: Gabourey Sidibe broke barriers, defied stereotypes and is defining her own success.

item.title: Washington Irving Library in Bushwick Wins BKLYN Robotics League Championship
item.description: Teen teams from across Brooklyn competed in the BKLYN Library Robotics League, with Washington Irving Library emerging as the repeat champion.

item.title: Brooklyn Museum Names Robert Wiesenberger Senior Curator of Contemporary Art
item.description: The Brooklyn Museum welcomes Robert Wiesenberger as its new Senior Curator of Contemporary Art, expanding its commitment to bold exhibitions and contemporary voices.

item.title: Feb 8: Brooklyn Black History Maker, Busta Rhymes
item.description: Busta Rhymes has 11 Grammy Award nominations for his huge contribution to rap.

item.title: Downtown Brooklyn’s Former Macy’s Becomes a Living Art Display
item.description: “In Every Transition, A Pattern” is a rhythmical expression of the urban environment along Downtown Brooklyn’s renowned retail corridor.

item.title: NYC Youth Invited to Apply For Free Sleepaway Camp
item.description: New York City children and teens can apply for The Fresh Air Fund’s free Mid-Hudson Valley sleepaway camps featuring outdoor activities, arts, sports and leadership development.
